question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.

Barren

"Can you believe how much traffic there is today?", grumbled Tom, glancing at the congested road ahead.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Congested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Barren"** means lacking in vegetation and life; unable to produce much or any vegetation. (बंजर)
 
 
• **Example: **The barren landscape stretched as far as the eye could see, with no signs of life.
 
 
 
• **"Congested" **refers to an area that is overcrowded or filled to excess, often causing delays or blockages. (भीड़-भाड़ वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The congested streets made it difficult to drive through the city during rush hour.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Barren' **is **'Congested'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Congested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Believe **(विश्वास करना): Accept something as true; feel sure of the truth of.
 
 
• **Example:** He couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Grumbled **(बड़बड़ाना ): Complain or protest about something in a bad-tempered but typically muted way.
 
 
• **Example: **She grumbled about the long wait at the doctor's office.
 
 
 
• **Glancing** (झांकना): Taking a brief or hurried look.
 
 
• **Example:** He kept glancing at his watch during the meeting.
